source.title: Electronegativity of low-pressure high-density oxygen discharges

metadata.power_definition: Total prescribed absorbed power, including ion-wall energy; not generator RF power
metadata.frequency_note: This prescribed-power chemistry study does not solve frequency-dependent CCP heating
metadata.individual_rate_domain: k20 from paper section3.4 p1107 requires 1<Te<4.5eV; bound-pinned points fail

assumptions.edge_factors: hL=hR=.05,.1,.2,.4: exploratory inputs, not density-dependent electronegative transport
assumptions.diffusion: 10 mTorr reference outputs scaled .5,1,2; 1 mTorr uses its own reference outputs
assumptions.gamma_o: .15-.19 is published .17±.02; .05 and .5 are wider hypotheses, not Si measurements
assumptions.gamma_meta: .007 originates from Fe; .001 and .03 are sensitivity assumptions
assumptions.momentum_collision_frequency: Each target O and O2 has 0,1e7,1e8 s^-1 as an assumption; total frequency is twice this value. Zero is an omitted-elastic limiting case
assumptions.surface_temperature: Not specified; gas 600 K is not wall temperature
assumptions.flow: 50 sccm at STP273.15K/101325Pa; neutral-only pumping closure

metadata.reference_role: Deviation is descriptive, not a pass criterion or proof of validation

source_corrections.basis: Both reactants contain two oxygen atoms; add product multiplicity 2 to conserve oxygen.
Three reactant densities require coefficient m^6/s; numerical value preserved.
Move the printed [O2] density factor into explicit three-body mass action; do not double-count.
Add emitted electron for charge conservation; separate printed [O] factor into third reactant.

omitted_reactions.reason: Printed reaction destroys one positive charge without an electron. Replacing O2+ with neutral O2 would conserve charge but is an unverified interpretation, so the solver excludes k49.
omitted_reactions.effect: Full 49-reaction reproduction not achieved; no success assertion permitted.
